detail.longDescription: Your 02:30 cron job might run twice on October 25. When the clocks go back, 02:00–02:59 happens twice (US: 01:00–01:59 on Nov 1). What a 02:30 job does depends on what reads your crontab: Debian cron, cronie: once systemd timers: once BusyBox crond (Alpine): twice Kubernetes CronJob: twice In March the hour vanishes and the last three skip the run. Charts, CSV and a cron line checker: https:// runwisp.com/blog/cron-daylight -saving-time/ # cron # sysadmin # selfhosted
